title: The Truth of Ten Thousand Years
next_chapter_hook: Just as the figure identical to him was about to turn, the illusion shattered abruptly, and a familiar, nauseating aura gushed from the cracks—it was the unique pressure of Ling Yuan.

text.content: As the world spun, Chen Ji felt himself engulfed by an immense, unparalleled force, his consciousness plummeting into an abyss. The next moment, the light faded, and he found himself standing on a vast altar. Mist swirled around, seven stone pillars carved with mysterious runes formed a formation, and at the center stood a grand altar with pale blue flames burning upon it. The flames were cold rather than hot, chilling souls. Above the altar hung a blood-red full moon, though not a real sky—it was the manifestation of Cang Yutian's divine consciousness.

dialogue.content: (Looking around, suppressing the surging unease in his heart, he spoke coldly) This is... a memory from ten thousand years ago? Cang Yutian, what do you want us to see?

text.content: His response was thunderous laughter, filled with ten thousand years of vicissitudes and madness. At the same time, a figure cloaked in black mist appeared at the other end of the altar—the fragmentary soul of the demonic path commander. Chen Ji recognized that aura, identical to the previous demonic path commander, yet more ancient and fragmented, like a flickering candle on the verge of extinguishing. Their gazes met in the void, and without a word, they understood each other's predicament.

Time within the illusion seemed to reverse. The runes on the altar began to glow, and seven beams of light shot into the sky, dyeing the heavens a brilliant gold. Seven figures emerged from the light pillars, each radiating a terrifying aura that made this realm tremble. The leader wore white robes, with features so handsome as to be almost demonic, a faint smile playing at his lips—it was Cang Yutian in his youth, the supreme chess master before fate's backlash. Behind him stood six others, each unique, yet all were the most powerful beings closest to the Heavenly Dao of their era.

dialogue.content: (Within the illusion, the young Cang Yutian spread his arms wide, his voice grand and seductive) Fellow beings, the Heavenly Dao is dead, and justice does not exist! All seven of us are abandoned chess pieces of the Heavenly Dao. Instead of being manipulated, let us join hands to slay it, using our fragments of fate to reshape a new heaven! Then, this world will no longer be bound by the Heavenly Dao, and we shall all become lords of creation!

text.content: The voice pierced through time and space, striking Chen Ji's spirit, making him shiver. He glanced at the fragmentary soul of the demonic path commander beside him, noticing its phantom trembling violently, clearly deeply moved by this memory. The six chess masters all responded in agreement, seven hands pressing simultaneously onto the altar, the pale blue flames surging wildly, engulfing them—this was the final step of the alliance ritual, the beginning of intertwined fates.

Yet in the next instant, the scene shifted abruptly. The originally united seven suddenly showed fractures—someone discovered Cang Yutian's undisclosed secret. It turned out that 'reshaping the Heavenly Dao with fragments of fate' was not an equal offering, but a complete absorption of the other six's fate fragments, allowing Cang Yutian alone to gain the authority of the Heavenly Dao! An earth-shattering battle erupted on the altar, the six chess masters jointly besieging Cang Yutian, only to discover this was a meticulously planned slaughter.

dialogue.content: (Within the illusion, Cang Yutian crushed a chess master's heart with one hand, his voice ice-cold) I wished to preserve your corpses intact, but the Heavenly Dao does not permit it. What do you think the Heavenly Dao is? It is merely a tool I use to harvest fate. Rest assured, when I achieve enlightenment, I will remember every fragment of fate you contributed.

text.content: Chen Ji watched the bloody scenes in the illusion, his knuckles white. He finally understood why the demonic path commander chose to cooperate with him—it was not a stopgap measure, but a blood feud buried ten thousand years ago. In the scene, Cang Yutian refined the five chess masters completely, torrential fate power rushing into his body. However, just as he was about to complete his transformation, a backlash force erupted abruptly, sealing both his physical body and divine soul entirely.

Only the demonic path commander escaped at the final moment by splitting his soul, yet from then on he became a remnant soul, wandering for ten thousand years before reconstructing a physical body, never to regain his former glory. In the illusion, Cang Yutian was bound by countless chains, falling into the depths of the heavenly realm, yet his laughter never ceased, echoing between heaven and earth.

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji laughed coldly, his voice dripping with mockery) A fine supreme chess master, a fine reshaper of the Heavenly Dao! So the so-called Tianji Record is merely bait you used to seek the Twins of Fate. My encounter and alliance with the demonic path commander—all were part of your scheme?

text.content: The scene in the illusion shifted again, Cang Yutian's voice coming from all directions, carrying ten thousand years of dormant spite and madness. Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply as two infants appeared in the scene—one shrouded in light, the other enveloped in darkness—they were the Twins of Fate, the key to unsealing Cang Yutian. He finally understood that from the beginning, his sister Chen Nian and he himself were the two most crucial pieces in this chess game.

Yet at this moment, an不应该存在的光芒 appeared at the edge of the illusion. It was a blurry figure, standing at the outermost part of the alliance ritual, yet never mentioned in any record. His features were deliberately erased by some force, but that silhouette, that aura, was identical to Chen Ji himself. Cang Yutian's laughter stopped abruptly, the illusion trembled violently, as if some truth forcibly suppressed was breaking free from its chains.

choice.prompt: Who was this erased seventh person? Why did Cang Yutian erase his existence? Faced with this truth that could overturn all understanding, Chen Ji must make a choice.

choices.description: Concentrate all spiritual awareness to attack Cang Yutian's consciousness core, and while he is distracted by erasing the seventh person's truth, tear through the illusion to escape
choices.visible_cost: Consuming massive mental energy, may backlash
choices.visible_reward: Directly obtain crucial clues about the seventh person
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian's consciousness is extremely powerful, direct confrontation carries very high risk

text.content: Chen Ji's eyes turned crimson red, the Tianji Record Fragment in his Mental Sea运转crazed, gathering all power into an invisible blade of spiritual awareness. He abruptly raised his head, staring directly at the blood-red full moon—the core of Cang Yutian's divine consciousness—and thrust hard. The illusion trembled violently, countless cracks spreading through the void.

choices.description: Control your temper and don't reveal your intentions, secretly observe the details of the seventh person, wait for Cang Yutian to expose more flaws
choices.visible_cost: Temporarily unable to change the situation of being controlled
choices.visible_reward: To more completely understand Cang Yutian's trump cards and weaknesses
choices.risk_hint: Cang Yutian may perceive your intentions

text.content: Chen Ji suppressed the surging killing intent in his heart, his mask-like expression preventing anyone from seeing his true thoughts. He slowly drew back his gaze, seemingly bowing his head in resignation, but in truth his divine sense had already carved every detail of the seventh person into his soul. Seeing this, Cang Yutian smiled satisfied, thinking the prey had surrendered.

choices.description: To turn the tables, deliberately showing weakness in the illusion, secretly establishing a deeper soul connection with the Demonic Path Commander's fragmented soul to accumulate power for breaking the situation
choices.visible_cost: Requires candid confrontation with the Demonic Path Commander's fragmented soul, which may expose one's own secrets
choices.visible_reward: Gain the battle experience and soul secret techniques accumulated over ten thousand years by the Demonic Path Commander
choices.risk_hint: The Demonic Path Commander's fragmented soul is not necessarily trustworthy

text.content: Chen Ji quietly stepped back, seemingly unintentionally approaching the Demonic Path Commander's fragmented soul. His divine sense slightly fluctuated, transmitting an encrypted message—the unique fate resonance of the Tianji Record. The Demonic Path Commander's fragmented soul trembled slightly, then responded with the same frequency of fluctuation. Under Cang Yutian's very nose, the two completed the most covert alliance.

flags_set: 获得万年灵魂秘术传承

dialogue.content: (Cang Yutian's voice sounded again, this time with bone-piercing coldness) Chen Ji, you think I can't see through your little schemes? No matter what you choose, you cannot escape my chess game. The twin stars of fate, neither can be lacking. Your sister's life rests in my hands; and you, are merely a chess piece I've raised for twenty years.

text.content: These words were like a heavy hammer, violently striking Chen Ji's heart. Yet his expression on his face didn't change at all, merely slightly curving the corners of his mouth, revealing a meaningful smile. This was the moment he had been waiting for—the more urgently Cang Yutian threatened him, the more it proved he feared certain variables. And that erased seventh person might just be Cang Yutian's greatest weakness accumulated over ten thousand years.

choice.prompt: Cang Yutian's mockery intensified the tense situation, while the mysterious seventh person's figure remained faintly visible at the edge of the illusion. Chen Ji had to decide his next move.

choices.description: To respond to mockery with mockery, publicly exposing the flaws in Cang Yutian's ten-thousand-year scheme, letting him know that even a 'chess piece' has the ability to bite back
choices.visible_reward: Destabilize Cang Yutian's mindset, possibly revealing more truth
choices.risk_hint: Provoking an ancient monster of ten thousand years will have unpredictable consequences

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji chuckled lightly, his voice clear and bright) Ten-thousand-year chess master? Hmph, I'd like to ask, after arranging this scheme for so many years, you still had to personally intervene to trap two juniors—is this masterful chess skills or running out of tricks? That seventh person... could the reason you erased his existence be because he is the one who truly threatens you?

choices.description: No longer responding to Cang Yutian, focusing all attention on the seventh person's figure, trying to see his true appearance before the illusion completely dissipates
choices.visible_reward: Clearly see the seventh person's key features
choices.risk_hint: The illusion may dissipate at any moment

text.content: Chen Ji erased all expressions, even proactively收敛了神识fluctuation, minimizing his presence. His gaze firmly locked onto that hazy figure, branding every detail deep into his soul. The patterns on the robes, the posture of standing, even the faint scent—all were identical to Chen Ji himself.

flags_set: 识破第七人身份关键线索

text.content: Just at this moment, the illusion trembled again. Cang Yutian's voice became sharp and urgent, clearly Chen Ji's words had struck his vital point. That hazy seventh person's figure began to become clear, Cang Yutian frantically imposing suppression on that figure, but was blocked by an equally ancient power. The clash of these two forces shattered the entire illusion, presenting Chen Ji with an unprecedented opportunity.

Chen Ji saw it. In the final instant before the illusion realm completely collapsed, that figure turned around, locking eyes with him. It was a face completely identical to his own, yet with an entirely different gaze—weathered, compassionate, and a trace of relief. He opened his mouth and spoke a word silently. Chen Ji understood the lip language: "Find him." The next moment, the illusion realm shattered, and Chen Ji was thrown back into reality.
Just as the figure identical to him was about to turn around, the illusion realm suddenly collapsed. A familiar, nauseating aura burst forth from the cracks—it was Ling Yuan's unique dominance.
